scope: Current 53 independently purchasable paid KONAMI AppIDs, including available paid preorders; not all KONAMI games ever published
inference: Final price exports do not identify original list prices or purchase packages. Historical baselines are inferred from reviewed transitions and recurring ceilings and cross-checked against current pinned-package API prices. Fractional discounts are estimates, not asserted advertised Steam discounts.
edition_policy: Complete base-game editions may continue by AppID. Collection-only preorders and non-independently-sold bonus content do not count as individual games.
zero_rule: Zero/blank prices are unknown; no extrapolation after the final timestamp. A duplicate terminal blank is not a zero-price event.
day_rule: Positive-duration sale evidence confirms a JST sale day. A negative historical day requires coverage of the full eligible day; valid API observation follows the existing sampling rule.
